claims.text: THE LAKEBED HAS BEEN PHOTOGRAPHED FROM THE AIR, LEGALLY, AND THERE IS NOTHING ON IT. Tyler Rogoway of The War Zone published aerial images taken on a pilot's authorised flight directly over Papoose Lake: 'nothing appears to be there, just as satellite images show. There isn't even an access road and, as you can see, the lakebed is flooded, which is a fairly common occurrence.' Rogoway states his own position in the same piece: 'No, I don't believe Bob's story, but I do think that it is one of the most entertaining tales ever told.'

title: Tyler Rogoway, The War Zone, aerial photographs of Papoose Lake taken on an authorised overflight
